plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official 2026-2027 American Baptist College catalog, 'DEGREE AUDIT SHEET for GENERAL STUDIES ASSOCIATES DEGREE' (catalog pp. 63-65). 20 courses x 3 credits = 60 credits. All ABC courses are 3 credit hours; total_credits equals the sum of ALL semester course credits including choice slots. The catalog's course-description header states 'Prerequisite to all Bible Courses is BST 1010'; the audit-sheet sequence places BST 1010 (Year One, Spring) before all other Bible courses, so it is documented here rather than repeated as a machine prereq. Focus area = 18 hours (6 courses) including required courses: the Year One Spring slot is the intro-level course for the focus area, the Year Two Fall hybrid slot resolves per focus area ('PST 3080 Field Education I (for Pastoral Studies students) or BEH 2010 Introduction to Service Learning (for Human Services students)' — transcribed verbatim; note the catalog's Human Services minor course list does not include BEH 2010), and the remaining four slots are focus-area courses. transfer_confidence is 'core_only': ABC is a private four-year college with no published TCCNS/articulation equivalencies for these courses, so tccns mirrors the local course code.

Focus areas (18 hours / 6 courses, including required courses): Pastoral Studies — PST 1010 Introduction to the Practice of Christian Ministry & Cultural Competence (required), PST 3080 Field Education I (required), plus four PST courses at the 1000/2000/3000 levels chosen in conversation with the advisor (may include CMU 2020 Black Church Music and/or CMU 2010 Music Ministry & Leadership); Church Administration — PST 1010 and PST 3080 required, remaining courses from PST 2020 Challenges & Opportunities in Digital Ministry, PST 3040 Pastoral Ministry, Finance, & Administration, PST 3053 Family Ministries in the Church, PST 4030 Faith & Public Policy, COM 3060 Writing for Social Media, LST 1020 Developing the Healthy Leader, LST 2020 Enhancing Leadership for Technology, LST 2040 Leadership Principles for Business & Ministry, LST 4010 Business Law, LST 4030 Strategic Planning & Decisionmaking, MAT 3010 Business Finance, MGT 2000 Foundations of Management, MKT 3000 Principles of Marketing; Bible & Homiletics — 6 courses from BST and THG courses at the 2000, 3000, and 4000 levels chosen in conversation with the advisor; Human Services (minor) — BEH 2040 Foundations of Addictions, BEH 3010 Intervention & Prevention, BEH 3030 Service Learning II, SOC 3010 Conflict Management & Crisis Prevention, HMS 3010 Human Services Administration, HMS 3020 Human Services Administration II (prereq HMS 3010), HMS 3030 Individual & Family Assessments; Data Analytics (minor) — DAT 1010 Introduction to Data Science (required) plus five of STAT 1010 Statistics for Data Science, DAT 2010 Introduction to Excel, DAT 2030 Introduction to Programming with Python, DAT 3010 Visualization: Telling Stories with Data (Power BI), DAT 3020 Ethics for Data Science, DAT 4010 Applied Capstone.
